# Frame Design System — AI Implementation Guide

Use Frame's public design foundation and published components to build AI product interfaces. Import ./frame.css once, wrap Frame content in frame-root, reuse the installed components before creating new UI, and treat automated checks as support rather than a replacement for human review.

## Public references

- Design principles: https://system.beibeidesign.com/#principles
- AI interaction patterns: https://system.beibeidesign.com/#ai-patterns
- Operating guide: https://system.beibeidesign.com/#operating-guide

## Installed components

- ChatMessage: User and assistant message presentation with a visual streaming state.
- ChatPanel: Conversation layout with message and composer slots and near-bottom scrolling.
- ChatInput: Prompt composer with callback-based sending, optional attachments and mentions. No model provider is included.
- MessageCard: Inline event notice with information, success or warning tone and an optional action slot.
- StatusTag: Semantic status pill for pending, processing, review and completed states.
- Tag: Compact neutral label with an optional outline and tooltip.
- SidePanelBody: Scrollable conversation inspector body with spacing and an automatic scrollbar.
- SectionCount: Compact count label for grouped messages, references or workflow steps.
- TimePill: Compact time or effort label using the shared status presentation.
- StepIndicator: Visual pending, active and completed workflow step marker; pair with a text label.
- SecondaryButton: Secondary action button for prompt or workflow decisions.
- TertiaryButton: Outlined action button for quieter conversation and workflow actions.
- GhostPillButton: Pill-shaped secondary action with optional icon and disabled state.
- HeaderIconButton: Named icon action for conversation headers; size the mobile hit area to at least 44 pixels.
- MenuRow: Workflow or conversation selection row with optional secondary text and current state.
- IconBadge: Decorative icon badge for message context or workflow groups; not an interactive control.
- TextButton: Quiet text action with disabled and disclosure attributes.
- UtilityChip: Compact context action with optional pressed state for prompt toolbars.
- SummaryFooter: Compact elapsed-time or summary line beneath a conversation result.
- ChoiceCard: Selectable title and description card for choosing a prompt or workflow option.
- ReviewItemCard: Presentational review-result row with type, time and completed state; does not implement a review workflow.
- EmptyState: Icon and explanation for an empty message, result or reference area.
- VersionRow: Version comparison and update-status presentation without a network or update client.

docs: React 19, ReactDOM 19, TypeScript and lucide-react 1.14.0. Import the accompanying frame.css once and wrap Frame content in a div with className="frame-root". Set the wrapper background to var(--color-bg-page) and color to var(--color-text-primary), or supply a matching host surface. Add dark to an ancestor or that wrapper for dark mode. CSS is generated from Tailwind 3 and scoped; it does not replace your Tailwind config or global theme. Optional microphone and voice features are off in examples. The full install includes every component currently marked published plus FRAME_AI_GUIDE.md. Import ./frame.css once. Review LICENSE at the source repository.
